name: Return to Valanaar

angles.text: The blessing invoking the four winds reflects the cultural and spiritual ties common among the defenders and leaders of Valanaar.

aliases: who sends you back to valanaar
faq.answer: The quest is given by Yorna following a hard-fought defense against hostile attackers at an outpost, tasking you with delivering a status report back to leadership.
Valennia Stormfist is stationed in Valanaar and awaits word regarding the safety and operational status of the outlying defenders.
faq.q: Who do you report to in Valanaar?

faq.answer: Yorna's Report contains an update confirming that the defenders have stabilized their position against the assault and are mopping up what remains of the attacking forces.
The outpost defended by Yorna and her forces is the eastern watchtower, a critical defensive position watching over the approaches to Valanaar.
While some mopping up remains to clear the lingering attackers, the defenders have secured the position and the situation at the watchtower is considered stable.
faq.q: What is the status of the eastern watchtower?

aliases: may the four winds bless you
faq.answer: The phrase 'May the four winds bless you' and Valennia's exclamation 'Thank the winds' indicate a cultural reverence for the winds and elements held by the defenders of Valanaar.
faq.q: Why do the defenders speak of the four winds?

sections.body: Following a fierce assault on the outpost, defender Yorna sends word back to the settlement of Valanaar. With the attacking force broken and the remaining hostiles being mopped up, an adventurer is dispatched with Yorna's Report to relieve the anxious leadership awaiting news in the town.
sections.title: Word from the Outpost

sections.body: The dispatch carries word directly to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar regarding the condition of the eastern watchtower. Upon receiving confirmation that the tower has held and the perimeter is stabilized, Valennia expresses visible relief, offering thanks to the winds that their critical frontier remains secure.
sections.title: Relief in Valanaar

summary: Return to Valanaar is a quest where an adventurer delivers Yorna's report regarding the defense of the eastern watchtower back to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. The report confirms that the perimeter has been stabilized and the remaining attackers are being cleared out, bringing welcome relief to the settlement's leadership.
attribution: In-game quest text: Return to Valanaar
